lines.trans: Oh, the collectors' victim! Did you want something?
Yes. I came to say thank you and ask forgiveness.
What for?
I offended you. I was wrong.
That's how naughty you are.
Really, thank you.
But I just don't know how to thank you.
Alright, all sorts of things happen. Oh, come on.

words.gloss: what (ну что вы = oh come on)

lines.trans: Calm down. Everything is behind us now.
Have a seat. Everything is fine now, it's all over.
There, that's wonderful. That's normal.
A man must help a woman, right?
And a woman must help a man.
What do you think you're doing?!
But you said yourself that you want to help!
But you don't know how! And I know!
You have lost your mind!

words.gloss: went off (сошли с ума = lost your mind)

бывать.gloss: to happen, to be (sometimes); to visit

meanings.en: to happen, to exist, there can be
meanings.note: 3rd person бывает = there is / can be

examples.text: У мужчины бывает не только жена.
examples.trans: A man can have more than just a wife.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
A man must help a woman, right?

всякий.gloss: every kind of, all sorts of, any

meanings.en: all sorts of, every kind of
meanings.note: всякое бывает = all sorts of things happen
на всякий случай = just in case

examples.trans: Alright, all sorts of things happen.
Take an umbrella just in case.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)
adds emphasis to the word before it
person harmed by a crime or accident

examples.trans: She became a victim of fraud.

meanings.note: the thing that ends is the subject
деньги закончились = the money ran out

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know

examples.trans: The debt collectors call every day.

meanings.note: adult male; declines like a feminine -а noun

examples.text: У мужчины бывает не только жена.
examples.trans: A man can have more than just a wife.
This man is waiting for you.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: You are wrong in this argument.
He is not a good person.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence
+ prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

meanings.en: to offend, to hurt someone's feelings

examples.trans: Sorry, I didn't mean to offend you.
He didn't want to offend anyone.

meanings.note: кого-то за что-то = someone for something

examples.text: Но я просто не знаю, как вас поблагодарить.
examples.trans: But I just don't know how to thank you.
She thanked him for his help.

meanings.note: всё уже позади = it's all behind us now

examples.trans: Calm down. Everything is behind us now.
The hardest part is already behind us.

meanings.note: the person helped is in the dative: 'помогать маме' = to help mum

examples.trans: I wanted to ask you something.

meanings.note: as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine

examples.trans: Security will be here any moment.

присесть.gloss: to sit down (for a moment), to take a seat

meanings.en: to sit down, to have a seat

examples.trans: He sat down on the chair.

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness, apologise

examples.trans: He is asking me to forgive him.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

сойти.gloss: to get off; (с ума) to go mad

meanings.en: to get off, to step down
сойти с ума = to go mad, to lose one's mind

examples.trans: What, have I lost my mind?

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for
уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: сойти с ума = to go mad, lose one's mind

meanings.en: to calm down, to settle down

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.

meanings.note: я что-то вижу = I see something
colloquial, used as an adverb: что-то я не вижу = somehow I don't see it
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
